'''Beebo''' was a heavyset [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked at [[Aurek Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as a merchant during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beebo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He originally appeared as an [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]], but like the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] trainer [[Muheeda]], his [[Species/Legends|species]] was later changed to Human for some reason.<ref name="TOR" />
